transform="scale(2, 3)" on an outermost svg element computes to matrix(2, 0, 0, 3, 0, 0)

transform="skewX(30)" on an outermost svg element computes to skewX(30deg)
transform="skewY(30)" on an outermost svg element computes to skewY(30deg)

transform="translate(10, 20) rotate(90)" on an outermost svg element computes to translate(10px, 20px) rotate(90deg)
